map.某缸喷油量偏低会造成该缸混合气偏稀，表现为怠速抖动、冷启动困难、加速无力，并可能: A cylinder injecting too little runs lean, showing as rough idle, hard cold starts and sluggish acceleration, and can set a P030x misfire code; ongoing misfire also sends unburned fuel into the exhaust and damages the three-way catalyst. Too much fuel shows up as higher consumption, black smoke and heavier carbon deposits.
map.台架测试把喷油嘴装在专用设备上，以固定压力与脉宽连续喷射并称量各缸流量，结果最可: Bench testing mounts injectors on a rig and measures each one's flow continuously at fixed pressure and pulse width, giving the most comparable results. On-car cleaning introduces solvent through the intake or fuel line; it is cheap but limited against heavy clogging. Always retest over the same duration afterwards and compare flow and spray pattern.

map.偏差多少算不合格？: How much deviation counts as a failure?
map.行业常用参考：各缸偏差在 ±3% 内视为均衡良好；±3%~±5% 属轻微偏差，可: Industry practice: within ±3% is well balanced; ±3%~±5% is slight, so try on-car cleaning and watch it; ±5%~±10% is clearly out of spec and calls for off-car ultrasonic cleaning plus a retest; beyond ±10% usually means heavy clogging or valve damage, so replace that injector and code it.
map.免拆清洗通过进气或燃油管路引入清洗剂，成本低、施工快，对轻度积碳有效，但流量偏差: On-car cleaning introduces solvent through the intake or fuel line; it is cheap and quick and shifts light deposits, but does little once flow deviation is large. Ultrasonic cleaning requires removing the injector and lets you inspect spray pattern and sealing at the same time, giving a more thorough result and easy before/after comparison. Once deviation passes ±5%, go straight to off-car cleaning rather than repeating cleanings.
map.为什么必须用同一测量时长比较？: Why must every reading use the same duration?
map.各缸流量是「单位时间」的喷油量，测量时长不同会直接改变绝对数值，跨时长比较没有意: Per-cylinder flow is a rate, so changing the measurement duration changes the absolute number and comparing across durations is meaningless. Measure each cylinder in turn at the same pressure, pulse width and duration, then convert to mL/min for a valid side-by-side comparison.
